careerai.comment: Local MCP server shipped by this project (Phase 2). Expects the `careerai-mcp` binary on PATH. Build with `cargo install --path crates/careerai-mcp` from the project root.

linkedin-jobs.comment: Default LinkedIn discovery via RapidAPI's LinkedIn Data API. ToS-clean (no scraping). Free tier exists. Set LINKEDIN_RAPIDAPI_KEY in your env to enable; the server is harmless without a key but discovery calls will fail.

linkedin-browser.comment: Opt-in: browser-based LinkedIn scraper. Violates LinkedIn ToS section 8.2 (User Agreement: no automated access). Disabled by default. Flip `disabled` to false at your own risk; rate caps and cookie-jar rotation in careerai-submit still apply.
